_doc: Single source of truth for mici-nav route-steering test flags, tunables, and presets. Booleans live as files under /data/navd/flags/<name>; scalars live as files under /data/navd/<KEY> (NavParams). Read by nav_tune.py and applied to the device by ctk (preset/tune/navstate).

flags.navsteer: MASTER: inject nav maneuvers as model turn desires (DesireHelper instantiates NavigationDesires). Read at DesireHelper init -> REBOOT after toggling.
flags.navsteer_turn: Allow hard turnLeft/turnRight desires at intersections (gated < NavSteerTurnSpeed). Read live.
flags.navsteer_keep: Allow keepLeft/keepRight slight-turn / fork nudges. Read live.
flags.navsteer_handsoff: Drop the steeringPressed requirement on keep/slight nudges (fully hands-off). Read live.
flags.navslow: Longitudinal: decelerate toward an upcoming maneuver (clamps v_cruise, only-slower, jerk/decel-bounded). Read live.
flags.navhud_persist: Keep the HUD maneuver cue on continuously whenever a next maneuver exists (vs the final ~10s window). Read live.

NavSteerTurnSpeed.doc: Speed gate: hard turn desire only below this.

NavSlowTargetTurn.doc: Target speed to reach for a hard (left/right) turn.

NavSlowTargetSlight.doc: Target speed for a slight turn / fork / ramp.

NavSlowLookahead.doc: Max maneuver distance considered for slowdown.

NavSlowDecel.doc: Comfortable deceleration cap used for the slow-point onset.

baseline.doc: CONTROL: everything off, stock behavior, HUD windowed.

hud.doc: Isolate the persistent HUD change only (no steering, no slow).

slow.doc: Isolate longitudinal decel into turns ONLY (no steering injection).

turn.doc: Isolate hard intersection turn-steering (no keep, no slow).

handsoff.doc: Slight-turn nudge with the hands-on requirement dropped.

turn+slow.doc: THE intersection combo: hard turn steering + decel into it.

full.doc: Everything on (turn + keep + handsoff + slow + persistent HUD).
